name: What is the difference between a garage finish and a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a garage finish and a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard drywall finish provides clean, painted walls suitable for parking and basic storage, whereas a full conversion adapts the room into a conditioned living area, office, or gym. While a basic finish involves insulation, drywall, and trim, a full conversion may require subfloor leveling, supplemental heating, exterior door replacements, and adherence to residential room codes. A finish retains your ability to park cars, whereas a conversion permanently trades vehicle parking for square footage, which is a major lifestyle tradeoff to weigh.
acceptedAnswer.description: A finish adds insulation, drywall, and paint while preserving car parking; a conversion turns the garage into conditioned, heated living space like an office or gym.
